title: Open cancellation for counit-normalized section locality
statement: Fix the finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions] and a normalized etale compact-support presentation N. Let W,X,B be Noetherian schemes; let v:W→X be separated quasi-compact etale, h:X→B and q:W→B compactifiable, with v h=q. Let s:B→W and z:B→X satisfy s v=z. Let O⊆W be open and s′:B→O satisfy s′ ι_O=s, and assume ι_O q compactifiable. Then the normalized section locality for ι_O followed by the inverse normalized section locality for ι_O v equals the full canonical etale section comparison for v. Both source and target are the ordinary-etale section invariants; all comparisons retain their specified derived/exact pullback and structure-map congruences [lem-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-normalization, lem-pur-diagonal-section-pasting]. This holds for every N and includes empty schemes.

proof.text: The unique counit equation for etale ambient adjoint locality identifies the comparison constructed from any N with the chosen ambient comparison. Right-adjoint conjugacy of compact-support composition identifies locality for O→X with successive locality for O→W→X, retaining the inverse-image compositor.

Pull this identity along s′. The equalities s′ι_O=s and sv=z, with associativity of the canonical inverse-image compositors, identify the two section pullbacks. Cancel the invertible open-locality factor and invert full locality. By definition the latter is etaleSection. No Cartesian square of the open with a different base is needed.

theorem sectionEtaleRestriction_open_cancel (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient)
    {W X B : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian W] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian B]
    (v : W ⟶ X) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (h : X ⟶ B) (q : W ⟶ B) [HasCompactification h] [HasCompactification q]
    (hv : v ≫ h = q) (s : B ⟶ W) (z : B ⟶ X) (hz : s ≫ v = z)
    (O : W.Opens) (s' : B ⟶ O.toScheme) (hs : s' ≫ O.ι = s)
    [HasCompactification (O.ι ≫ q)] :
    letI : IsNoetherian O.toScheme := ⟨⟩
    letI := P.comparedExponent (𝟙 (Spec (.of P.field.k)))
    letI : HasCompactification (v ≫ h) := HasCompactification.of_eq hv.symm
    (P.chartSectionEtaleRestriction N O.ι q (O.ι ≫ q) rfl s s' hs) ≪≫
      (P.chartSectionEtaleRestriction N (O.ι ≫ v) h (O.ι ≫ q)
        (by rw [Category.assoc, hv]) z s'
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, hs, hz])).symm =
      DiagonalPasting.etaleSection P.Coefficient P v h q s z hv.symm hz.symm
